chapter: Early career: vaudeville and Kansas City
title: Why he wanted show business: travel, carnivals, excitement
summary: Basie says he loved the show and had always wanted show business, travel and carnivals more than being a musician as such.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: That was a show. Did you like it? Did you like doing it?
Show business, that's what I wanted.
Well, why did you want show business?
I don't know. I just wanted show business, just nothing big enough.
Yeah, well, there was nothing so glamor show business about. It was just a show, was just performance, (inaudible).

That's it. I just wanted to get down and I wanted to travel. I used to want to just do everything, wanted to be a part of show business. When I was a kid, I mean, there was very little that you could see (inaudible) theaters and maybe some of the acts would come to the theater, you know, and then when the carnival things would come to town, (inaudible).
So that your first impulse wasn't to be a musician. You really wanted to be in show business.
Uh-huh? Yeah. Uh-huh. Would you say that's what a lot of other musicians wanted --
I couldn't say. I don't know how they felt about it (inaudible).
Uh-huh, okay. So it broke up and I guess it shouldn't have broken up.
Gonzel. Shouldn't have broken up, I guess. But it did.
